quote_zh: 向反应瓶中加入2-甲基-2-戊醇200mL，开动搅拌，室温下将4.2g氢化钠(60％，0.105mol)滴入其中，待氢化钠溶解完全后，控制釜温在25℃，将34.8g2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(98％，0.1mol)倒入釜中进行碱解反应
arithmetic_check: Charges. Sodium hydride 4.2 g at a stated 60 percent strength is 2.52 g of hydride against 0.105 mol, implying 24.0, and NaH is 24.00: exact. Methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate 34.8 g at a stated 98 percent is 34.10 g against 0.1 mol, implying 341.0, and C10H10BrClO4S is 341.60: low by 0.16 percent, inside rounding. So molar_mass_inconsistent is NOT raised. Stoichiometry implied by the printed moles is 1.05 mol of hydride per mole of ester; no equivalents are printed, so the equivalents fields are left null rather than computed into the record. Product closure. No mass and no yield are printed for this step's product: the solvent is stripped and the residue is carried straight into step (2), and the only product figure is an in-process normalised content of 97.8 percent. There is therefore no mass balance to test and mass_balance_implausible is NOT raised. Continuity. Step (2) charges 0.1 mol of this product, the same molar quantity that was charged of the ester here, so the patent carries the step through as if quantitative. Since this step states no output quantity there is no mismatch between a stated output and a stated input, and scale_discontinuity is NOT raised; the implied lossless carry-through is recorded in notes instead. All numbers transcribed as printed.

quote_zh: 向反应釜中加入200mL DMF、11.6g三氟乙醇(99％，0.115mol)和5.4g氢氧化钠(96％，0.13mol)，开动搅拌，控制釜温在5℃，将步骤(1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐(97.8％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为3h，加毕保温反应6h。
arithmetic_check: Charges. Trifluoroethanol 11.6 g at a stated 99 percent is 11.48 g against 0.115 mol, implying 99.9, and C2H3F3O is 100.04: low by 0.2 percent. Sodium hydroxide 5.4 g at a stated 96 percent is 5.18 g against 0.13 mol, implying 39.9, and NaOH is 40.00: low by 0.3 percent. Both inside rounding, so molar_mass_inconsistent is NOT raised. The benzoate salt is printed as a strength and a mole figure only, 97.8 percent and 0.1 mol, with no mass, so it yields no molecular weight to test. Implied stoichiometry per mole of salt is 1.15 of the alcohol and 1.3 of the base; not printed as equivalents, so those fields stay null. Product closure. Limiting reagent 0.1 mol of the benzoate salt. Product 2-chloro-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid is C11H10ClF3O5S, 346.70, so theory on 0.1 mol is 34.67 g. Printed crude mass 32.4 g is 93.5 percent of theory on mass alone; at the printed 96.5 percent HPLC content the contained product is 31.27 g, which is 90.2 percent of theory. The patent states 89.7 percent over both steps on the methyl ester, and the methyl ester basis is itself 0.1 mol, so the patent's figure and the figure implied by its own printed mass and content agree to within about 0.5 of a percentage point. That is inside the rounding of a three-figure mass, so the step CLOSES and neither mass_balance_implausible nor scale_discontinuity is raised. Note for A5: the 89.7 percent is a two-step yield on the methyl ester, not a step yield, and it is stored in product_yield_pct with that basis stated in notes. All numbers transcribed as printed.
